description: Return the exact text a wallet signs so Mamo opens a new USDC, Bitcoin, Ethereum or MAMO Account for it; nothing else needs it (a stocks portfolio opens by transaction). A Sign-In-with-Ethereum message for `personal_sign` (EIP-191): it moves nothing and cannot be replayed as a transaction; it proves ownership to Mamo's backend, which deploys the Account and pays the gas. Sign `message` byte for byte, then pass it and the signature to `create_account`. The signature does not expire and cannot be revoked: pass it only there, never paste or share it, and expect it to stay in this client's transcript. Never ask for a private key.

account.description: Which Account the sign-in is for, if already decided: `usdc_stablecoin`, `cbbtc_lending`, `eth_lending` or `mamo_staking`. Only used to name it in the follow-up; the signature is the same either way.

address.description: The wallet that will own the Account, 0x-prefixed, on Base.

name: prepare_sign_in
title: Get the message a wallet signs to open a Mamo Account
